questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: How perfume is made in factories and sold in department stores
How smells link to memories and what scent says about us
Why deodorant is important
The best places to buy perfume
questions.why: Perfumer Roja Dove talks about smells triggering memories and the message scent gives off.

questions.q: What does Roja Dove do for a living?
options: He sells expensive perfume in a big department store
He writes about fashion
He creates very exclusive, expensive perfumes
He studies the brain
questions.why: Neil says he designs and creates very exclusive and very expensive perfumes.

questions.q: According to Roja Dove, what is our sense of smell like when we are born?
options: The smell part of the brain is empty, so we learn responses
It is stronger than any other sense
It is the same as an adult's
It doesn't work at all during the first year of our lives
questions.why: He says the part of our brain that deals with smell is empty, 'so we learn our response to smell'.

questions.q: What happens when we smell an odour again, according to Dove?
options: We stop noticing it
We feel sick
We want to buy it
It brings back the original memory
questions.why: He says it's like a trigger that will 'revive the original associational memory'.

questions.q: Why does Dan feel nostalgic in the perfume area of a department store?
options: He used to work there
He smells a perfume someone close to him used to wear
He bought his very first bottle of perfume there as a teenager
It reminds him of his holidays
questions.why: Dan says he can smell the perfume that someone from his past used to wear.

questions.q: What kind of scent does Dove suggest to seem strong in business?
options: Sweet, fruity scents
Light, fresh scents
Woody, mossy scents
No scent at all
questions.why: He suggests 'very, very woody, mossy, structured scents called Chypres'.

questions.q: What does Dove think about the message our scent gives off?
options: It matters a lot and shouldn't be underestimated
Most people don't notice it
It only matters in business
It is less important than the clothes that we choose to wear
questions.why: He says the message you give off with scent 'can't be underestimated'.

questions.q: What is Dan joking about at the end?
options: Neil's powerful aftershave
Neil's expensive perfume
Neil's new suit
The smell of Neil's egg sandwich
questions.why: Dan says 'I was thinking more of the egg sandwich you had for lunch.'
